Bellingshausen, a Russian Antarctic station on King George Island, lies in an area visited on short trips from Punta Arenas.

Excursion programmes also highlight a Russian Orthodox church. A visit to the station offers a glimpse of how scientific work and everyday life are organised amid the cold coastal landscapes.

Belo Horizonte, the capital of Minas Gerais, combines leafy neighbourhoods, museums and modern architecture. The city's most recognisable attractions are associated with Pampulha and the work of Oscar Niemeyer.

On a longer itinerary through Brazil, Belo Horizonte is particularly useful in combination with Ouro Preto. The city offers an airport and modern infrastructure, while the historic part of the journey continues through the old towns of Minas Gerais.

On a 14-day itinerary through Rio, Ouro Preto, Salvador, Praia do Forte and Iguazu, Belo Horizonte is a convenient flight connection after visiting Minas Gerais. A short stop here is usually sufficient before continuing the journey.

Bento Gonçalves is a town in the wine-producing region of southern Brazil. Hills, vineyards and small estates shape the surrounding countryside and the character of a visit. Here, the natural landscape is closely connected with local gastronomy and winemaking traditions.

Exploring the region usually centres on winery visits, where guests learn how the estates operate and, when included in the itinerary, take part in tastings. Between visits, there are views of country roads and vineyard-covered slopes. Bento Gonçalves fits naturally into an itinerary through southern Brazil, combining wine experiences with Porto Alegre and the natural areas of Rio Grande do Sul.

Bernardo O’Higgins National Park encompasses remote landscapes of Chilean Patagonia, including glaciers, mountain slopes and a network of marine channels. Much of the exploration takes place from the water. The scenery changes as the vessel travels: dark shores and forests give way to glacier fronts, snowy summits and floating ice.

Cruise itineraries may include a passage through the fjords of the Peel area and approaches to glaciers, including Amalia Glacier. The exact sequence depends on the itinerary, weather and ice conditions. The park offers an opportunity to experience the scale of Patagonian glaciation and a coastline where the natural landscape defines almost every aspect of the journey.
